features.name: Phenotype: extract embedded HPO terms
features.description: The challenge supplies phenotype as 8 embedded HP:####### IDs plus protected Presentation/Notes. Write scripts/extract_hpo.py to pull IDs from word/document.xml with stdlib zipfile, fetch and provenance-record hp.obo, resolve labels, verify populated context rows, and write notes/phenotype.md. Record reviewed non-verbatim context: seven proband phenotypes, one parental/family-history signal, broad timing, organ-system domain and concise clinical significance; never emit narrative, exact ages, dates or measurements. Also record the negative: the document names no karyotype, prior genetic testing or candidate gene, so the search stays genome-wide rather than collapsing onto BUB1B/CEP57/TRIP13. The broader toolchain remains feat-003.

Exact wording and quantitative details remain local. hp.obo release 2026-06-23, SHA-256 a5092cbdf605f568403cf7380d9173014015692433b2cc631bc5c1b053876b1b. features.name: VCF triage baseline
features.description: Annotate the provided joint VCF and produce the first candidate table - the reproducible baseline every later ranking is compared against. Known specifics: keep PASS only (4,740,790 of 5,012,204), drop the 116,485 records on alt/random/decoy contigs, and carry the no-chr <-> chr conversion explicitly since submissions are matched by exact tuple equality. Primary genetic model is COMPOUND HETEROZYGOUS (two rare damaging alleles in one gene) - both the scoring code's answer key and the absence of any ROH point there; de novo dominant is the second model. Rank against the full feat-002 multi-system constellation. Treat seven terms as proband observations and `HP:0200067` as a separate but clinically meaningful family-history feature within the phenotype input—not as a proband abnormality and not as disposable background. It can inform inherited and newly arising mechanism hypotheses but does not distinguish them.
features.evidence: scripts/run_vcf_triage.sh, scripts/build_coding_regions.py and scripts/rank_candidates.py implement the checkpointed offline baseline. `./scripts/run_vcf_triage.sh --self-check` passes; the review-corrected full run retained 4,661,873 PASS primary records, produced 4,727,745 normalized biallelic records, reduced them to 308,080 exon-window records and 29,701 VEP coding/splice records, then ranked 364 hypotheses from 418 rare damaging alleles. `notes/vcf-triage.md` records commands, thresholds and the leading BUB1B compound-het pair. Source-VCF re-query independently confirmed both ranked alleles are PASS 0/1 calls with DP/GQ 46/99 and 28/99. Final `./init.sh` output is recorded in progress.md.

features.name: GC-corrected copy-number and BAF screen
features.description: The provided VCF contains no CNV or structural records at all (genotypes are only 0/1, 1/1, 1/2), so MVA's defining mosaic aneuploidy is invisible in it. A quick 10 Mb BAF/depth screen (notes/data-profile.md) excluded high-level aneuploidy but left chr20 (and 19, 22) unresolved and confounded with GC/mappability bias. Redo it properly with GC-corrected read-depth binning and a mappability mask so the chr20 signal is either confirmed as low-level mosaic trisomy or attributed to bias. Small and targeted - this does not require re-calling the genome.

features.name: Targeted realignment for missed alleles
features.description: OPTIONAL, contingent on feat-004's candidate list. Justification is recovering a second compound-het allele that Sentieon's diploid germline caller could have dropped - deep-intronic, structural, or repeat-adjacent - NOT aneuploidy detection, which feat-005a handles more cheaply. Realign the 8 FASTQ lanes (or only the intervals around surviving candidates) and re-call with a mosaic-aware caller. Real cost: ~385 GB decompressed, zcat alone is ~1 h serial, and the box is contended (load avg 109 on 64 cores, 3 of 5 A100s busy). nohup into logs/ and never block the session.

features.name: Local scorer and submission conformance
features.description: Only 6 Track 1 submissions exist; none should be spent discovering a formatting bug. Vendor the challenge's public evaluation.py and track1_submission_template.csv into scripts/ and self-score every candidate CSV locally first. Must enforce: proband_id is exactly PROBAND01; chrom fields are chr-prefixed (the scorer only .strip()s them, so unprefixed names silently score zero); at most 10 rows; strictly distinct epcr values in (0,1] since ties collapse F-max thresholds; indels left-aligned and represented as the answer key would have them. Strategy note: rows with epcr BELOW the true row are free - they cannot lower F-max and do not move rank points - so fill all 10.

features.name: Make this repository public
features.description: Every Track 1 submission requires a GitHub URL starting with https://github.com/ - this blocks the submission, it is not a Track 2 afterthought. The current tree is data-safe, but the 2026-09-02 disclosure audit found two short non-HPO protected-text overlaps in reachable commit 05ed1cc. Before public visibility, rewrite that commit out of all reachable history with explicit authorization, force-push the configured origin, repeat the protected-text audit plus `git log --all --pretty=format: --name-only`, confirm .gitignore and the pre-commit gate, then flip visibility and record the URL.

features.name: Track 1 submission
features.description: Ranked variant CSV matching static/templates/track1_submission_template.csv (proband_id, chrom/pos/ref/alt per allele, epcr, finding_type, notes), self-scored via feat-006. Three hard requirements at upload: the CSV, a report file (.pdf or .md) describing the approach, and the public GitHub URL from feat-007. Scored on rank points (rank 1 = 100, ranks 2-3 = 50, 4-5 = 25, 6-10 = 10, partial match 0.5x) and F-max. Limit 6 submissions; best one counts.

features.name: Track 2 drug repurposing report
features.description: Mechanism characterization for the top variant(s) and approved-drug candidates targeting the disrupted pathway. Deliverables: detailed report, public GitHub link, and a 3-minute recorded pitch video. Judged on rigor 35 / impact 25 / innovation 25 / scalability 15. Limit 1 submission, no re-submissions. The organizers state publicly that care for this child 'means managing symptoms and fighting cancer cells' - malignancy should anchor the mechanism argument, but the report must also explain the renal, growth, muscle and perinatal constellation and distinguish parental reproductive history from proband findings.
